A [[Gran/Legends|Gran]] '''driver''' of an [[EasyRide passenger airspeeder/Legends|EasyRide passenger airspeeder]] was [[Death/Legends|murdered]] by [[Ashaar Khorda]] after driving him to his destination on Coruscant.

==Biography==
[[File:GranTaxiDriver2.jpg|left|thumb|270px|Ashaar Khorda killed the driver]]
The [[Gran/Legends|Gran]] worked as an [[EasyRide passenger airspeeder/Legends|EasyRide passenger airspeeder]] driver.<ref name="zam" /> In [[27 BBY/Legends|27 BBY]],<ref name="SWTCC" /> he drove [[Ashaar Khorda]] to the lower levels of [[Coruscant/Legends|Coruscant]], while Khorda planned to use an anienct [[Infant of Shaa|idol]] to make the planet erupt. The talkative driver told Khorda about thethe different levels of Coruscant throughout the journey, explaining that the upper levels are on tourist maps, while he would not even want to walk on the lower levels. He almost crashed into a vehicle driven by a [[Rodian/Legends|Rodian]] during the journey, causing him to angrily exclaim that he believes Rodians cannot drive properly. The driver was heistant to let Khorda off in the lower levels, as it was an unsafe place to be, but Khorda insisted it was the right place. As the dirve asked for the fifteen [[Galactic Credit Standard/Legends|credits]] Khorda owed him and offered to help him with his box, Khorda murdered him by stabbing him in the neck with a knife, before getting off and using the airspeeder's controls to cause it to fall, along with the driver's body, many stories to the ground.<ref name="zam" />

==Personality and traits==
The driver had strong opinions about the different levels of Coruscant, believing that the presitigious upper levels were deliberately put on maps and that people could eat off the upper walkways, while also saying that he would not even want to walk on the lower levels. He complained about gangs and disreputable types in the lower levels, and he seemed to care for his passengers, as he warned Khorda to be careful in the lower levels, and seemed heistant to let him get off at a rough and unsafe address. And he was also xenophobic towards Rodians, as he loudly exclaimed that they cannot drive properly. And he be very talkative and to enjoy making conversation without listening to others, and he constantly talked thoughout the journey, while his passenger remained silent.<ref name="zam" />
